title: LangSmith tracing is enabled
explanation: The image environment turns on LangSmith tracing, which sends prompts, outputs and traces to the LangSmith service. LANGCHAIN_TRACING_V2 is the older name for the same switch.
fix: Remove LANGSMITH_TRACING / LANGCHAIN_TRACING_V2 from the image, or point LANGSMITH_ENDPOINT at a self-hosted instance inside the enclave.
